stem: A pharmacy receives its first DEA registration and will begin stocking controlled substances tomorrow. What inventory event is required?

choices.text: Use the out-of-state prescription rule when its schedule, age, and verification conditions have not been checked.
Process another refill because an authorization written by the prescriber overrides schedule limits.
Treat the request as an insufficient-stock partial fill and use the 72-hour remainder rule.
Take an initial inventory of controlled substances on the date controlled-substance activity begins.
Handle the drug or transaction as ordinary Massachusetts Schedule VI activity.

explanation.core_reasoning: A newly registered handler must take an inventory of controlled substances on hand on the date first engaging in controlled-substance activity. The pharmacy must use the exact trigger and deadline rather than borrowing a nearby controlled-substance rule.

choice_analysis.A: That choice belongs, if at all, to Out-of-state Schedule III through VI prescriptions; its trigger does not match this scenario.
choice_analysis.B: That choice belongs, if at all, to Federal Schedule III and IV refill limits; its trigger does not match this scenario.
choice_analysis.C: That choice belongs, if at all, to Schedule II partial fill caused by pharmacy inability; its trigger does not match this scenario.
choice_analysis.D: This applies Initial controlled-substance inventory: A newly registered handler must take an inventory of controlled substances on hand on the date first engaging in controlled-substance activity.
choice_analysis.E: That choice belongs, if at all, to Massachusetts Schedule VI prescription-drug status; its trigger does not match this scenario.

related_facts: A newly registered handler must take an inventory of controlled substances on hand on the date first engaging in controlled-substance activity.
explanation.mpje_trap: Applying out-of-state iii-vi to facts controlled by initial inventory.

reasoning_steps: Identify the trigger for Initial controlled-substance inventory
Separate the controlling pathway from a nearby rule with a different schedule, deadline, or setting
Apply the exception and documentation conditions before selecting the final pharmacy action
